instruction: Open the Settings page inside Thunderbird as a tab.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened About Profiles tab by navigating hamburger menu > Help > Troubleshooting Information, scrolling down, and clicking the about:profiles link. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird hamburger menu, open Help submenu, access Troubleshooting Information, scroll pages, find and click internal about: links to open new tabs.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same menu navigation capability with a different target: opening Settings (about:preferences) tab instead of About Profiles. Settings is directly accessible from the hamburger menu, making this a similar-difficulty variation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Thunderbird Settings tab. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for a 'Settings' tab in the tabmail-tabs tab list, matching the pattern of the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the live accessibility tree XML, which contains the UI state needed to verify if a Settings tab is open.

CSS selector 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Settings"]' precisely targets a Settings page-tab within Thunderbird's tab bar, directly verifying the instruction.
check_accessibility_tree metric correctly parses the XML and applies the CSS selector, returning 1.0 if the element exists and 0.0 otherwise.
Complete coverage: the instruction is a single-step task (open Settings as a tab) and the evaluator fully verifies this by checking for the Settings tab's presence.
No postconfig needed since the accessibility tree is read from the live running environment after the agent acts.
